requirements: R1: Add distinct structural attributes and validation for protocols.
R2: Add distinct structural attributes and validation for raw epidemiological data.

slices.title: Implement structural attributes for protocols and data
slices.jtbd: When implementing specific entity types for this epic, I want to extend the existing materials entity to support distinct structures for protocols and raw data, so that researchers can search and view them accurately.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user wants to add a protocol, when they submit the details, then the system validates and stores protocol-specific attributes.
Given a user wants to upload epidemiological data, when they submit the data, then the system validates and stores data-specific structures.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the rate of missing domain-specific attributes for protocols and data from 100% to 0%

epics.title: Revision History for Materials and Protocols
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiological protocol or material description is updated, I want the system to track previous versions and maintain a revision history, so that I can audit changes and revert to older versions to ensure clinical compliance and procedural safety.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of documented and auditable protocol changes from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: Implement version control and tracking for epidemiological protocols and materials.

slices.title: Add versioning to materials API
slices.jtbd: When implementing versioning for this epic, I want to add revision tracking to existing material endpoints and services, so that historical versions are preserved and retrievable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing protocol is edited and saved, when the backend processes the update, then it stores a historical revision including author and timestamp.
Given a request to view a protocol's history, when the client calls the endpoint, then the API returns a list of past versions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of untracked high-risk protocol modifications from 100% to 0%

requirements: R1: Fix the application launch failure and ensure health checks pass.

slices.title: Fix local environment launch and health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the launch fix for this epic, I want to resolve the container/startup errors, so that the application successfully boots and passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application is in a failed startup state, when I apply the launch fixes and start the environment, then the product successfully boots.
Given the application has started, when the health check endpoint is probed, then it returns a healthy status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce application startup failure rate from 100% to 0%
